main_text.p: ipsi [illegible, ~8 letters] tenerent, primi senten-tias dicerent, ab omnibus magistratibus olim iisdem assurgeretur. Deinde & ager iis latior assignatus fuit à Lycurgo, ad tuendum statum regium, modicus tamen, qui nec indigere eos mediocri-bus, nec affluere divitiis permitteret. In cænis quoque & conviviis publicis duplex portio ipsis est tributa, ut haberent, quod aliis, quos honorare volebant, possent elargiri: ex singulis sacrificiis pars aliqua regibus data: ex quolibet scropharum partu porcellus unus iisdem cessit, ne sacra facturis victima unquam deesset. Erant omnium sacrorum administri quasi sacerdotes, & sacrificabant frequenter. Adhæc habitabant domo publicâ, & utebantur publicis tabernaculis tum ad cænas, tum ad usus alios, semperque secum habebant contubernales Pythios, binos & CIIIII-os, quos pro re natâ mitterent ad consulenda oracula: Pythios etiam & 2xenos, quibus cura excipiendorum stractandorum hospitum publicorum demandata, soli pro arbitrio suo [illegible, ~6 letters]nabant: causas virginum ἐπι- seu [illegible, ~7 letters], quibus solis tocarentum bæreditas obveniebat, 2que certatim à pluribus procis ferè pete-

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment, continued from the previous page. Greek words in the first line and after "ἐπι-" are illegible at this scan resolution. Most left-margin notes are illegible: their letters and numbers are given as far as they can be read, and their Greek is not transcribed. Words cut at the left edge of the column ("-os", "nabant", "tocarentum") are partly illegible due to the binding and the margin notes. The faint text at the far right edge is show-through or the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
